entities.name: Chaney
entities.description: An ancient archdruid in Aerona on Dominaria who claimed to be a planeswalker and taught Greensleeves.

entities.name: Greensleeves
entities.description: Young druid and planeswalker trained by Chaney, who absorbed her life force.

entities.name: Gull
entities.description: Member of Greensleeves's army whom Chaney healed of an old knee wound.

entities.name: Aerona
entities.description: Region of Dominaria where Chaney lived.

entities.name: Stone Brain
entities.description: Artifact Greensleeves donned whose ultimate secret lay in the ruins of the College of Lat-Nam.

entities.name: College of Lat-Nam
entities.description: Ruins where the Stone Brain's ultimate secret was buried.

events.summary: Greensleeves meets Chaney in northern Aerona and is taught to harness mana and about planeswalking.
events.quote: Chaney taught Greensleeves how to harness mana

events.summary: Greensleeves trains for about five years while only days pass outside, emerging years older and a more skilled wizard and druid.
events.quote: Despite training for around five years, only a few days passed.

events.summary: Chaney dies of mortality in 4074 AR and her life force is absorbed by Greensleeves.
events.quote: In her dying moment, her life force was absorbed by Greensleeves.

events.summary: Chaney returns as a shade urging Greensleeves to make the final sacrifice, then passes on after Greensleeves dons the Stone Brain.
events.quote: Three years later, Chaney returned as a shade

relations.quote: Chaney taught Greensleeves how to harness mana
